notes: Ringwalt Avenue: name RINGWALT printed west of the strip (x 6200-6500), AVE. printed on the diagonal part; taken as one street. Lafayette Circle is a loop whose two arms leave the strip to the north-west; no junction with another street inside x>6520 except Marjorie. Dell Eva Lane: 'DELL EVA' and 'LANE' printed apart at x 6250-6450 and 6650-6800. STEPS printed in a walk from Lafayette Circle (6690,4110) south to Severn Avenue (6690,4555): not a street. OLD WATER WAY: a 20-40 ft strip from the plate edge (7480,440) winding south-east to a dead end near (8230,2180); meets no street, not recorded as a street. Vine Street: name printed at (9450,5480); east side cut by plate edge, centre taken on the car tracks. Woolper/Vine recorded as T; plate cut hides anything east of Vine. Greendale name printed west of strip at x 5550-5800. Severn Avenue west end is a dead end at about (6400,4597), outside the margin.
